children: Tuesday it was collaborating with Amazon Web Services
for technology offerings to mid-sized companies, focusing on cloud migration, security, data management, and artificial intelligence.

The offerings, available through AWS Marketplace, include tools for moving virtual machines to AWS, finding and optimizing cloud spending, securing cloud systems, and testing AI systems for potential risks.
Offerings are part of Accenture Edge, a business launched for companies with annual revenue of $300M to $3B.

The collaboration also includes customer service technology, including conversational AI and virtual agents, as well as tools to help companies identify data sources and dependencies during cloud migrations.

Accenture said one customer, 407 ETR, an electronic toll highway operator in the Toronto area, worked with its NeuraFlash unit and AWS to build a new customer service system while keeping its existing operations running.
